lock.why: RE-LOCKED v244 on the same 28 Jul lot, at the 06 Aug count. The lot has not changed; what changed is the leak behind it and the attribution in front of it. The 33.14 count took the observed rate from 16.19% to 18.87%, and SHRINK_ATTRIB went to 1, so the whole leak is now carried in the price and nothing is absorbed. Effective cost RM53.19 to RM60.01. These numbers are the unlocked path’s own output, captured rather than hand-computed: the lock was deleted, pxCost() run fresh at attrib 1, and the result written back here. Absorbed is 0 by definition at full attribution.

costRule.note: His settled rule of 05 Oct 2026, every book alike: COGS a unit is the latest purchase entry's quote plus its trip freight, over its units (the position engine's latestCogs; no freight typed counts as nought). The floor is that times the size and nothing else: no leak, no delivery, no time. The leak is still measured and reported, and the stack's after-leak figure is printed beside the floor as information only.
